description: Checks a domain against SURBL's multi-list (multi.surbl.org): whether it appears in spam or phishing URI lists. Listed domains return a 127.0.0.x code. Not listed means not in SURBL's current lists, not that the domain is safe. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
